Read the text and answer the question as an ordinary reader of English. Answer with exactly one of: yes, no, cannot tell.

protocol.calls: one fresh context per call: no system prompt beyond PROMPT, no earlier turns (G2)
protocol.parse: first line, lower case, letters only: 'yes' / 'no' / 'cannot tell' (also can't tell); else invalid
